items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only says 'Lester?' in response to the interviewer reading a biography about W.H. Young's family; no personal interaction or relationship is described.

ctx.x: "Born, Woodville, Mississippi, 27th August 1909. Brother of Lee Young. Their father W.H. Young, who had studied at Tuskegee Institute, tutored Lee, Lester and their sister Irma. Several other relatives were musicians, including the New Orleans trombonist-bassist named Austin "Boots" Young" [that's the one you mentioned, Boots] "and saxist Isaiah "Sport" Young. The family moved into New Orleans during Lester's infancy. He was taught trumpet, alto sax, violin and drums by his father. By the time the family had…
